commits.reason: Drops the shared MCP types block from durable code mode's codemode section because pi-codemode stopped exporting MCP_TYPESCRIPT_PREAMBLE and mcpStructuredContentSchema(). pi-codemode here never had them, so the port of 8bb180bec renders the section without that block already.

cliFlags.reason: pi-rust ships ACP mode (pi --mode acp, ported from pi-acp); an ACP client relaunches pi with this flag for Terminal Auth. Upstream pi has no ACP mode.
